name: workspace-test-config
goal: Every normal test entrypoint, root and each workspace that inherits the root Vitest config, loads its setup from the owning config and collects its own tests.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: 4ded check:planning failed before collection: planning has no Vitest config, inherits root vitest.config.ts, and the relative globalSetup test/svelteKitConfigs.ts from 62a2c504 resolved under packages/planning (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND, no test files).

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test that faithfully reproduces the defect; record proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged 4ded: planning bun run test exit 1 with the same errors. Guard test/workspace-test-config.test.ts (da67bd16): nested-workspace case fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND; root-entrypoint case passes.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Name the root-owned globalSetup from the owning config (fileURLToPath of import.meta.url); keep setupFiles relative so inheriting workspaces keep their own setup. Guard: real Vitest from root and from an unconfigured nested workspace.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: vitest.config.ts owned() resolves test/svelteKitConfigs.ts from the config file. Guard in the normal root unit suite. AGENTS.md and local skill rule for owned config paths and the entrypoint matrix.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same guard 2/2. check:planning 18 files/50 tests; root cold focused 10/10; root test:unit 200 passed, 2 skipped (784 tests); typecheck, lint, format, audit, units, scenarios, explain pass.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated copy with the 4ded vitest.config.ts: guard nested case fails again (1 failed, 1 passed); fix restored: 2/2; guard bytes identical in the copy.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and keep pending while proof fails.
Process retro: root-only acceptance missed nested config inheritance; durable guard and config-change rule.
steps.evidence: 62a2c504 was accepted from the root entrypoint only; an unconfigured workspace inherits the root config with workspace-relative paths. Rule: owned paths from the owning config plus the root/nested entrypoint matrix; guard enforces it.

steps.title: The guard's Vitest subprocess is bounded inside the 60 s test allowance and a timed-out run fails the guard explicitly.
steps.evidence: spawnSync timeout 45000 ms with SIGKILL; timedOut asserted false. Guard 5bc63518: fix 2/2, 4ded config rejected, restored 2/2; probe with a 1 ms limit fails both cases as timed out.
